patch_list: Removes the PairIP LicenseActivity from AndroidManifest.xml.

Unlocks all premium features in JellyWatch TV. Premium entitlement is server-verified against verify.jellywatch.app and surfaced to the UI as a PremiumStatus data class (isPremium = first boolean field); the patch forces that field to true…
